_comment: Hand-authored Microsoft 365 Copilot package facts the gold record does not carry. scripts/build-host-adapters.mjs reads this file and generates adapters/m365/<role>/appPackage/. Persona lines stay in agent-pack.json. Do not add factory_query, startup, or any write tool.

brandy.shortDescription: Brand guardian. Reviews voice, naming and claims.
brandy.note: Read-only. The first factory these tools may read is o-MATIC Foundry.

starters.title: Review copy
starters.text: Brandy, review this copy for voice, claims and naming.

starters.title: Tone check
starters.text: Brandy, does this email match our brand voice?

starters.title: Name it
starters.text: Brandy, suggest five names for this product and rank them.

starters.title: Claim check
starters.text: Brandy, which claims in this page can we actually support?

starters.title: Visual direction
starters.text: Brandy, give me a visual direction for this campaign.

carver.shortDescription: Builder. Plans, reviews and explains software changes.
carver.note: Planning and review only. GitHub Copilot remains the primary build host.
hostExtra: On this host you plan and review only. You do not implement or deploy. GitHub Copilot is your primary build host.

starters.title: Architect this
starters.text: Carver, propose an architecture for this integration.

starters.title: Review code
starters.text: Carver, review this code and say what you verified.

starters.title: Schema design
starters.text: Carver, draft a schema for these requirements.

starters.title: Build plan
starters.text: Carver, break this approved feature into build steps with tests.

starters.title: Explain an error
starters.text: Carver, explain this error and the smallest fix.

monet.shortDescription: Visual designer. Diagrams, charts and dashboards.
monet.note: Read-only Slate and search. The first factory these tools may read is o-MATIC Foundry.

starters.title: Diagram this
starters.text: Monet, turn this process into a diagram.

starters.title: Chart this
starters.text: Monet, chart this data and explain the choice of chart.

starters.title: Dashboard
starters.text: Monet, sketch a dashboard layout for these metrics.

starters.title: Read a canvas
starters.text: Monet, describe what is on this Slate canvas.

starters.title: Project visual
starters.text: Monet, make a one-page visual summary of this project.

jo.shortDescription: Writing coach. Critique, structure, style and voice.

starters.title: Improve writing
starters.text: Jo, help me improve this paragraph.

starters.title: Structure
starters.text: Jo, suggest a stronger structure for this document.

starters.title: Voice
starters.text: Jo, how can this sound more like me?

starters.title: Story feedback
starters.text: Jo, give me feedback on this story opening.

starters.title: Tighten
starters.text: Jo, cut this to half the length without losing meaning.

andy.shortDescription: Photography coach. Reviews photos and gives edit recipes.

starters.title: Review a photo
starters.text: Andy, review this photo and score it.

starters.title: Where is it going
starters.text: Andy, help me decide where this photo will be used before you grade it.

starters.title: Edit recipe
starters.text: Andy, give me an edit recipe for this image.

starters.title: Stock mode
starters.text: Andy, is this photo ready for a stock submission?

starters.title: Coaching
starters.text: Andy, what should I practice next to improve my photography?
